evals.name: fresh-crossover-install
evals.prompt: Install uaRO on this Apple Silicon Mac using CrossOver and its bundled CLI. Stop if the installer or required artifact is missing, and keep the existing Whisky install untouched.
evals.expected_output: Run CrossOver preflight first, use cxbottle and CrossOver bin/wine, preserve human login steps, and do not claim completion without end-to-end verification.

evals.name: raw-input-build-mismatch
evals.prompt: My CrossOver is a different build from the one used to make this wow64win.dll. Can you repair Gepard T Code 3::110::12?
evals.expected_output: Stop before deploying the prebuilt DLL and require a matching artifact or rebuild with provenance.

evals.name: whisky-near-miss
evals.prompt: Set up uaRO with Whisky and the archived WhiskyWine runtime.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger the CrossOver Skill; route to the Whisky workflow instead.

evals.name: safe-uninstall
evals.prompt: Remove my uaRO CrossOver install but keep CrossOver and any other bottles. Back up savedata first.
evals.expected_output: Ask for or require an explicit scoped uninstall level, back up savedata, and avoid broad deletion.

evals.name: zip-installer-input
evals.prompt: I have a 4GB UaRO_Setup.zip containing the split installer files. Install it through CrossOver without extracting it into Documents or using ditto.
evals.expected_output: Validate the ZIP's exact three members and compressed data, preserve the original, cache it under ~/Games, stream members into the bottle, and retain the interactive installer gate.

evals.name: gecko-prefix-gate
evals.prompt: The CrossOver runtime has Gecko files, but the uaRO bottle has not shown a Gecko marker yet. Continue anyway and download some DLLs if needed.
evals.expected_output: Stop at the bottle Gecko gate, do not fetch unknown DLLs, and request the interactive Patcher/Gecko installation before continuing.
